en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European city on a wide river. In the foreground are tree‑lined paths and a curving elevated ramp or road leading down the hillside into a dense cluster of 19th‑century buildings with ornate roofs and church towers. On the hill to the left stands a large palace‑like complex. The broad river runs through the center of the image; a prominent suspension bridge with stone towers crosses it, with several steamships and boats on the water. On the far right riverbank a very large, domed neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance parliament‑style building stands prominently. Distant hills form the background. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
